scenicChapters.title: Simplon Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 65 km this is Simplon Pass Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-swiss-alps-jungfrau-aletsch-il-sa.story: From Fiesch it runs 294 km to Fiesch; allow about 5 h 04 of riding. On the way it passes Sacro Monte Calvario, Sacro Monte della SS.Trinità, Sacro Monte del Rosario di Varese and Il Sabbione o settentrionale. The highest point is about 2,350 m. It crosses from Switzerland into Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
